summary: Surfaced while landing deliverable-verified-bytes-single-read (PR #389). The runner's single-read fix had to add a fallback keyed on `res.ArtifactPath == artifactPath` because those two are NOT always the same path: internal/phases/intent in DELTA mode dispatches intent-delta.md, while the intent entry in the phasecontract registry names intent.md. So deliverable.Verify judges a DIFFERENT FILE than the one the phase was asked to produce. A naive 'classify the bytes we verified' FAILed every intent-delta cycle, which is how it was found (phases/intent.TestRun_DeltaMode_IntentUnchanged_SKIPPED went red). The single-read fix routes around the skew and pins it with TestRun_DispatchedArtifactDiffersFromContractPath_*; it deliberately does NOT paper over the underlying defect. Reachable only with EVOLVE_INTENT_DELTA set (no in-repo caller), so this is an operator-mode path, not the default one — which is why it survived this long.
title: The contract gate verifies a file the phase was never asked to write — intent in DELTA mode dispatches intent-delta.md while its phasecontract names intent.md
